title: GO FISH KAUAI Sport Fishing Charters
specs: You must be able to walk and stand on your own to safely enjoy your trip.
One Fish up to 50 lbs. may be cut, packaged and shared among the guests on board to enjoy a couple meals while here on island .
With other charter companies having an average 25lb policy, we are one of the most generous companies on the island when it comes to sharing our catch for you to enjoy on vacation.

blurb: Experience the ultimate adventure with Kauai fishing charters! Whether you're a seasoned angler or a first-timer, Go Fish Kauai offers private & shared charters that let you explore the pristine waters of Kauai. Target big game fish like Marlin and Tuna while enjoying the beauty of the Pacific. Our experienced crew ensures you have all the gear and guidance needed for an unforgettable trip.
